name: Email-Ops
description: Privacy-first email cockpit: connected mailboxes, threads, the agent-inbox approval surface, mail triage, conversational provisioning, the Cleaner engine, and an agent-controls-the-UI (AG-UI) surface — over the Stalwart mail engine.

keycloak_jwt.note: Realm RS256 access tokens from the configured Keycloak (KEYCLOAK_URL / KEYCLOAK_REALM).

tools.name: health
tools.description: Liveness + configuration check (is tenancy enabled, server time).

tools.name: list_my_workspaces
tools.description: The organizations the caller is an active member of, with role + default.

tools.name: email_ops_health
tools.description: Per-workspace mail health: engine status, mailboxes, approval backlog, failed sends, the agent fleet.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: The workspace's registered agent fleet (key, autonomy L0/L1/L2, mailbox, pending count).

tools.name: provision_mailbox
tools.description: Create a mailbox (human/agent/shared); policy-gated, runs as the caller.

tools.name: provision_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent (key, autonomy, tier, manager); policy-gated.

tools.name: set_disposition
tools.description: Triage a thread into a folder (INBOX/ARCHIVE/TRASH/SPAM).

tools.name: set_sender_policy
tools.description: Block or trust a sender (address or domain).

tools.name: list_threads_with_contact
tools.description: The mailbox threads with a contact (the customer-360 email history).

tools.name: list_thread_messages
tools.description: The messages in one thread (bodies as previews only).

tools.name: compose_email
tools.description: Compose an outbound email; mode=send queues delivery, mode=draft stages the agent-inbox approval.

tools.name: list_connected_accounts
tools.description: Whether the caller has linked Gmail or Microsoft.

tools.name: get_inbox_stats
tools.description: Cleaner-engine inbox stats via the caller's brokered provider token.

tools.name: analyze_inbox
tools.description: Run the stateless Cleaner-engine analysis via the brokered token.

tools.name: plan_cleanup
tools.description: Build a dry-run cleanup plan (read-only; protected vs safe rows).

tools.name: clean_trash
tools.description: Stage a trash-cleanup batch into the agent inbox.

tools.name: clean_delete
tools.description: Stage a permanent-delete cleanup batch into the agent inbox (approval gates the backup check).

tools.name: organize_messages
tools.description: Stage an organize/archive batch into the agent inbox.

tools.name: unsubscribe_sender
tools.description: Stage an unsubscribe batch for a sender group into the agent inbox.

tools.name: undo_batch
tools.description: Best-effort audit reversal of a cleanup batch.

tools.name: list_agent_inbox
tools.description: The agent-inbox approval queue (agent-drafted messages awaiting human approval).

tools.name: approve_agent_inbox_item
tools.description: Approve a pending agent-inbox draft (the human-in-the-loop send).

tools.name: reject_agent_inbox_item
tools.description: Reject a pending agent-inbox draft (never sent).

tools.name: ui_navigate
tools.description: AG-UI: navigate the caller's open cockpit to an app route.

tools.name: ui_open_thread
tools.description: AG-UI: open a specific mail thread in the cockpit.

tools.name: ui_compose
tools.description: AG-UI: pre-fill the cockpit composer (does NOT send — the human sends).

tools.name: ui_switch_space
tools.description: AG-UI: switch the cockpit's active Space.

tools.name: ui_notify
tools.description: AG-UI: show a toast (an agent → human status message) in the cockpit.
